result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, bold tone centred on innovation and grand ambition, with confident absolute claims ('no one else can solve'). Uses corporate 'NVIDIA' third-person voice, not first person. Stakeholders are addressed only indirectly; the page leans on industry and society rather than specific commitments. Navigation includes Corporate Social Responsibility and Investors links, which are chrome and not coded.
